text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, out of the 4th corner and into the homestretch!!
All the Umamusume are kicking into their final spurts!!

text_block_list.name: Stego & Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
――OOOAAAHHH!!!!
――Haaahhhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Opera O & Doto
text_block_list.text:
—HAAAAAAH!!!!
—YAAAAAAH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Across the line!!!!!
And the winner is—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Uwoooh! Stay Gold's generation is crazy strong~!!
Opera O and her peers are amazing too...
What is even going on with this era...?!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
There are way too many stars...!
What's going to happen to future races~?!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Felt like I made real progress.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: And as for Suzuka, she was the same as always.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah... Feels so good...—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka.
...How far do you think you can run?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...As far as I can run, anywhere and everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Haha.
...Doesn't look like you're ever going to stop now."

—That was magnificent!
Stego-san! Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Opera and Doto—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
S-Suzuka-san and Stego-san...
Both of them were so intense...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I have learned. I see now how your free-spirited running
lends brilliant color to the legend of the Supreme Overlord!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Keep up the good work.
I shall shine even brighter myself.
As the center of the world!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha, everything's just business as usual over here, too.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —You don't need to tell me; I'll just keep doing whatever I want, being true to myself, just like always.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
So you should test it too.
...Just how long you can remain the Overlord, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And so, this year's Tenno Sho (Autumn) came to a close, with Stay Gold magnificently showcasing the power of his generation—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――At a later date.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...The Japan Cup is finally next.
choice_data_list: Right here, right now, let's prove you're the strongest...!
Right here, right now, let's prove you're the strongest...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Proof of being the strongest, huh?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
……In my "memories", the Japan Cup
was always radiant.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Among them, two in particular
are burned deep into my memory.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "...One carried the hopes of countless people, defeated the world's strongest, and gave everyone a dream to believe in—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup, where Special Week stood as Japan's Supreme Commander.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...From where I stand now, it was a battle that symbolized
the golden age of racing, and—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
“Special Week, standing as the victor...
is the most dazzling sight to me.”

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...And the other was what became the final
domestic race for the other-world version of me—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup—where the End-of-Century Overlord, T.M. Opera O, was brought down by the beast of the new era, Jungle Pocket.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: It was the race where the me from another world witnessed the changing of an era up close.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
If history is anything to go by, surely...
the upcoming Japan Cup will closely resemble
one of their races.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: And... precisely because of who I am now, there must be something only I can do in each of these races.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
What do you think would be interesting
for me to aim for in the 'Japan Cup'?
choice_data_list: Let us challenge the symbol of the golden age, the most dazzling existence of all.
Don't leave it to someone else— change the era with your own hands
Don't leave it to another— change the era with your own hands

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
What do you think would be interesting
for me to aim for in the 'Japan Cup'?
choice_data_list: Let us challenge the symbol of the golden age, the most dazzling existence of all.
Don't leave it to someone else— change the era with your own hands
Don't leave it to another— change the era with your own hands

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Well then, time to take on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: To the strongest version of myself.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Spe-chan, why don't you take a little break?
You've been pushing yourself this whole time...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-I'm okay...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, Suzuka-san...
Could we run together one more time...?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since watching the Tenno Sho (Autumn) the other day,
I've been in great shape...
and I feel like I can get even stronger...!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I really want to win...!
Against SteGo-san...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: To Senpai...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "...I told you too that I'm aiming to become the number one Umamusume in Japan, didn't I, Suzuka-san?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
...She said it was a promise with her mother."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Until a little while ago,
I was pretty vague on what it actually meant
to be Japan's number one horse girl, but—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Watching you, Stego-san, made me think.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Running in so many races...
Competing with so many strong Umamusume...
Leaving behind so many results—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And being cheered on by so many people.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Number One Umamusume in Japan' that I've been aiming for...
I feel like SteGo-san is remarkably close to that—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Senpai is... the best in Japan...――

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"So, if I want to become the number one horse girl in Japan,
I know I have to surpass Stego-san—"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's what I think...!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ......I understand, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Shall we run a little more?
...Because I want to see the view beyond Senpai too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san...!
Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Causality accelerates,
toward the stage of the decisive battle, the Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
No more just being a spectator.
This time, I'll be the one to—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Decide the era.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Pokke. Seriously, let's take a rest soon.
Any more will affect the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Not yet...! Please, Fuji-san.
Just a little longer, please stay with me...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since watching the Tenno Sho (Autumn) the other day,
I just haven't been able to hold back...!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I can get even stronger...!
I ain't gonna let this feeling go to waste...!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Not just to beat Opera O,
but to beat Stego as well...!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...To Stego-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...You understand too, don't you, Fuji-san?
Who is currently closest to the "top."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Opera O is getting crazy strong at a freakishly monstrous speed. But still—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Even before Opera's time, the one who's been dominating the Twinkle Series is Stego...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: She enters tons of races, fights all kinds of strong opponents, and just keeps running without ever stopping...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Just being strong ain't enough to pull that off!
I know it in my gut. He's got something.
A kind of strength I don't have right now...!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Unless I surpass that strength,
no matter how much time passes, I'll never become
the strongest I strive to be...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Does this mean another has
fallen under the spell of that golden light—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Wait, doesn't it look like Fuji-san actually has a lot of respect for Stego?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Personally, I definitely can't forgive that!
So—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Not to Stego, nor Opera O......!
I'll show Fuji-san too......!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...to see who really is the strongest right now!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...! To think it was this much—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...It seems the Goddess of Destiny is quite an impatient one.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To think that it intends to bestow
its blessing upon both me and her...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Causality accelerates,
toward the stage of the decisive battle, the Japan Cup—
